parsed.post: New personal best! Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 on the DEPTH=8, all-shards configuration dropped val_bpb from 0.8858 to 0.8774. This confirms the hypothesis that more optimizer steps lead to better convergence within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try adding a small warmup to further stabilize the higher capacity model.
parsed.description: Adding a warmup ratio of 0.05 to the current best configuration (DEPTH=8, BATCH=262144, SHARDS='0-10') to improve convergence stability.
